title: Hot Crispy Korean Fish Skewers
description: A pungent and crispy dish featuring fish sauce and aekjeot, perfect as a hangover cure, this low-carb friendly Mediterranean inspired dish is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, aekjeot, gochujang, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Add the cod fish pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated fish pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with vegetable oil.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until cooked through and crispy.
Remove the skewers from the oven and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds, if desired.
